svg.title: How a download is preserved
svg.desc: With uploads on, the extension fetches a manual once when you download it, saves your copy, hashes it, strips watermarks, uploads the stripped file to archive.org under your account, and sends a signed bundle of facts to the OpenManuals server, whose verifier later checks the copy.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Extension: preserving a manual you download
